card.name: Word just before a parent- or para- continuation
card.fires_on: Spots in drug-label text where the next word is likely to be a 'par-' form such as 'parenteral' or 'parent'. Examples are 'following' after 'more often', the middle of '1,000', partway through 'hypophosphatemia', and 'non' before 'intravenous'.

modes.label: Following after more often
modes.description: The word 'following' in the opioid adrenal insufficiency sentence.
modes.example: Cases of adrenal insufficiency have been reported with opioid use, more often<< following>> greater than one month of use.

modes.label: Inside 1,000 mg
modes.description: The middle zero of a number like 1,000 in iron dosing text.

modes.label: Partway through drug or condition names
modes.description: Inside hypophosphatemia, Monoferric, or the 'non' before intravenous.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward 'parent' words and away from unrelated tokens, though the link is weak.
card.plain: It fires at scattered points in iron and opioid label text where the model is mid-word or mid-number, with no single clear theme.
